title: Birth date, Lawrence Kansas and his minister father
summary: Brown corrects his birth date to August 3, 1907, says he was born in Lawrence, Kansas, to an A.M.E. minister, was likely named for Paul Laurence Dunbar, and recalls his mother playing organ in Fort Scott.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well now, let's start with correcting your birth date. I think you said you were looking at the Feather John Chilton's Who's Who of Jazz and Leonard Feather's Encyclopedia of Jazz, and which one is the right one?
Well, there have been several errors from time to time. I guess I gave out the wrong information from time to time, but my real birth date is August the 3rd, 1907. That's in the Chilton book.
And you were born in -- where?

I was born in Lawrence, Kansas, and my father was a minister. So therefore we were moved any time the Conference moved us, and I spent only a short time in the whole Kansas area. I would up to about my sixth year. And from there we were moved to Oakland, California, and from then on I've been in the western area.
Were you named for the city you were born in?
No, I think I was named after Paul Lawrence Dunbar. I think I heard my mother say something about knowing him or something of Paul Lawrence Dunbar.*
He was an A.M.E. minister. He'd also been a presiding elder. He'd been in the church practically
And are you -- what are your earliest recollections of music?

I think my mother played for the choir way back in Kansas. I have a faint recollection of her playing organ. That was when you used to pump the organ by foot, and we were in a town called Fort Scott, Kansas, and that was my first recollection. From then on the rest of the time that I was in Kansas, I was just -- I did nothing in music, because I was too young. In fact, I left Kansas when I was about six or seven. So I had no interest in music at all.
